#!/bin/sh
# Fake upcrun that just runs the program
# Usage: upcrun -n <num_threads> -shared-heap 256MB /app/pgen <input_file>
# We ignore options and just run the program with remaining args
# Find the program path (first non-option arg)
args=()
prog=""
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    -n|-shared-heap)
      shift
      shift
      ;;
    *)
      if [ -z "$prog" ]; then
        prog="$1"
        shift
        # remaining args go to program
        while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
          args+=("$1")
          shift
        done
        break
      fi
      ;;
  esac
done
exec "$prog" "${args[@]}"
EOF
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/upcrun
